skill_entry_layout.+0x00: u32 max upgrade level (2) or 0xFF (not upgradable)

meta.damage: see formulas.json damage; mult is per hit (1024 = x1.0), energy moves use POW and the target END2

skill_levels.set_by: script native (0x08003936 -> 0x08013B54) i.e. story/trainer scripts; not by use (no writes observed while using skills)

melee.hit: instant hit test on press: hit struct {dir, mult=0x400, attack type 0x086B8098 (melee sub 2), attacker} vs enemies overlapping the facing rect
melee.rect_format: x0, y0, x1, y1 (player pos x = left edge of the 16-px body, y = feet)
melee.after: player state 4/5/6 (random 4+rand(3)) = one of three punch/kick animations; Goku: 17 frames each before idle (VERIFIED emu, t_punchtime.py); next A only accepted in idle/walk
melee.ep_gain_on_hit: +1 EP per melee hit that deals damage (script #2; Armor of Light +2, Talisman of Light +1 more, Armor of Darkness / Vampire Cape: +1 HP instead)
melee.crit: chance (82*STR + crit_bonus)/65536 per melee hit unless attack sub == 3; crit = power*1.5

1.rule: needs EP >= 200 to start; drains while the beam is held

3.rule: needs EP >= 12; activate spends 2; drains while held

5.rule: spends 300 on activation, then drains while steering the dragon

6.rule: needs EP >= cost[level]; drains while held

7.rule: cost = ceil(maxEP*0xCCD/65536) (5%) per shot; activation + each refire

9.rule: needs EP >= 350 (0x15E); drains 4 EP every other frame while charging

11.rule: needs EP >= cost[level]; drains while held

12.rule: Fusion Dance: requires a fusion partner/conditions (0x03002C04 == 0, form flags); no EP

15.rule: needs EP >= cost[level]; drains while held

16.rule: needs EP >= cost[level]; drains while held

18.rule: Saiyaman: toggles Great Saiyaman form (always usable)

19.rule: unused slot (duplicate Saiyaman entry, canUse returns 0)

20.rule: Super Saiyan: needs EP >= 10 and record+4 (SS cooldown) == 0; second press reverts

22.rule: Super Saiyan 3: must already be SS (form flag 0x01) - see canUse 0x0801A55F

ep_cost_scaled_by: record+0x56/16 (Dragon Armor halves); while SS/SS3 the cost is taken from the SS/SS3 gauge
